frictions.description: Several sidebar/section navigation links and the floor-plan table button could not be clicked through agent-browser refs: 'Element is covered by <span/div/button ...> at its click point'.
frictions.resolution: Activated the same anchors/buttons with an in-page document.querySelector(...).click() (still navigation by clicking, no URL typing).

frictions.description: The agent-browser daemon restarted mid-session (about:blank + lost cookies), which silently invalidated the App operator session and the Sites customer session.
frictions.resolution: Re-ran both logins (App kody login and Sites OTP) and re-captured the customer token; the affected checks were re-verified afterwards.

frictions.description: Visiting ?lng=ar sets an httpOnly App locale cookie that persists across later App navigations, so the operator UI stayed Arabic after the RTL checks.
frictions.resolution: Re-opened the App with ?lng=en to restore English chrome before the locale-restore steps.

frictions.description: On /de/reserve the time-slot buttons have no accessible action word (text is just '12:00G4-Area'), unlike the English/Spanish pages; selecting a slot by text needed a regex on the time.
frictions.resolution: Clicked the first slot button by its time prefix via in-page JS.

frictions.description: Browser public writes share the per-IP durable rate-limit buckets (the browser cannot send X-Forwarded-For), so public bookings had to be kept to a minimum.
frictions.resolution: Two browser bookings total (VSWGG81H, 9ZTKHCY9) plus one curl booking with a private XFF identity; no 429 encountered.
